name: ledger
description: A /ledger pane over an append-only item ledger: what needs you, what is moving, and what was decided on which words. Reads through the ledger CLI only and never writes an event.

command.title: Ledger command
command.description: How to run the ledger CLI: `ledger` when it is on PATH, or `python3 -m ledger` with the folder below set.

folder.title: Ledger folder
folder.description: The working directory for the command, for `python3 -m ledger` from a clone or a vendored copy. Empty runs it from the session's own directory.

db.title: Database
db.description: The ledger database path. Empty uses LEDGER_DB from the environment.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads the ledger. 0 reads only on open and on Refresh.
